control.scope: Unpatched diagnostic control; collection job success is not recovery acceptance. Raw transcript/log/screenshots retained in the control artifact.

phone_parity.scope: Only HUD presentation and passive display-name registry change. Java DEX, native engine, remaining 36 compiled game modules and shipping project settings match the prior verified phone APK.

modal_visibility.method: Every complete UI snapshot in five actual Android transcripts is checked. Mobile and both lifecycle transcripts include full paused UI: no visible chain or gameplay buttons, modal controls available; playing restores both HUD actions. Ordinary/latched gameplay transcripts only retain complete playing UI, with condensed pause snapshots covered separately by existing touch regressions. UI headless tests separately cover hints and nested settings/build.

layouts.fixtures: Synthetic full-rank Vanguard and maximum-height Engineer: seven capped passives, four weapon slots, blocked Halo recipe. Same 188 requested layouts; new label bounds and content checks added. These are UI fixtures, not earned Android builds.

visual_review.observation: Native fixture shows two owned passives and correct caps. Full Vanguard/Engineer fixtures show all seven passives wrapped within the panel and reachable Back. Actual Mobile guide shows the honest empty passive row after an earned weapon choice; Resume restores combat/HUD. Positive passive acquisition is synthetic engine/UI coverage, not claimed as earned Android coverage.

limits: Ranked passive presentation is covered by synthetic engine/UI fixtures; actual early Android guide has no owned passives yet after its weapon choice.
Software Mobile emulator uses explicit Swappy off; normal ARM64/default shipping pacing unchanged.
Physical ARM64/S23 FPS, thermals, input latency and listening unverified. No local Android SDK/emulator/KVM; no local Xvfb executable, so rendered screenshots use CI.
